SELECT FROM tb_hr_cand c LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code j ON j.code_grp_id='JOB' AND j.code=c.job_cd LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code g ON g.code_grp_id='GRADE' AND g.code=c.grade_cd LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code s ON s.code_grp_id='CAND_SRC' AND s.code=c.cand_src_cd
ORDER BY
CASE WHEN c.cntc_stat_cd IN ('HOLD','CTRT') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC,c.input_psbl_dt ASC NULLS LAST,
c.cand_nm (SELECT code_nm FROM tb_sy_code WHERE code_grp_id='EMP_TYPE' AND code=c.emp_type_cd) j.code_nm g.code_nm c.hope_uprc c.input_psbl_dt (SELECT code_nm FROM tb_sy_code WHERE code_grp_id='CNTC_STAT' AND code=c.cntc_stat_cd) c.last_cntc_dt s.code_nm
DESCASC NULLS LAST,
c.cand_id ASC LIMIT #{query.size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM tb_hr_cand c WHERE c.cand_id=#{id}
SELECT skill_nm FROM tb_hr_cand_skill WHERE cand_id=#{id} ORDER BY sort_ord,skill_nm

SELECT c.cand_id AS "id",b.clnt_nm AS "companyName",j.code_nm AS "job",g.code_nm AS "grade",s.code_nm AS "source",u.user_nm AS "consentUserName" FROM tb_hr_cand c LEFT JOIN tb_bs_clnt b ON b.clnt_id=c.blng_clnt_id LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code j ON j.code_grp_id='JOB' AND j.code=c.job_cd LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code g ON g.code_grp_id='GRADE' AND g.code=c.grade_cd LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code s ON s.code_grp_id='CAND_SRC' AND s.code=c.cand_src_cd LEFT JOIN tb_sy_user u ON u.user_id=c.prvc_agre_user_id WHERE c.cand_id=#{id}
SELECT code AS "code",use_yn AS "useYn",del_yn AS "delYn" FROM tb_sy_code WHERE code_grp_id=#{group} AND code=#{code}
SELECT clnt_id AS "id",clnt_type_cd AS "type",use_yn AS "useYn" FROM tb_bs_clnt WHERE clnt_id=#{id} FOR SHARE
SELECT COALESCE(max(cntc_sn),0) FROM tb_hr_cand_cntc WHERE cand_id=#{id}
